verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents team creation with role assignment for members (vast-ai-docs-50) and scoped API keys limited to specific permissions for CI/CD or shared tooling (vast-ai-docs-5, docs-19, docs-24), directly covering the core ask. Missing for 10: no detail on granular spend/budget caps per member or role, no audit-log evidence, and no independent/community corroboration of team-role enforcement in practice.
